title_zh: 折返协议——人字线场景卡统一运营合约(机器可读)
title_en: The Switchback Protocols — machine-readable operating contract for all RENLINE scenario cards

status_enum.yellow: 受控试点 controlled pilot (gates: virtual_evaluation -> controlled_site -> limited_real_street)
status_enum.red: 折返 switchback: revert to last stable state with public explanation

belt_wide_defaults.non_smart_fallback: 15-minute-walk ordinary-equivalent service path; non-smartphone and accessible paths designed in parallel
belt_wide_defaults.ledger: Switchback Ledger entries published at quarterly Switchback Days as the counterpart of the honor wall
belt_wide_defaults.disclaimer_zh: 全部时限为设计目标值,非政府承诺;正式时限以运营协议为准。所有场景为概念建议,不表述为已批准运营。
belt_wide_defaults.disclaimer_en: All time limits are design targets, not government commitments; formal limits per operating agreements. All scenarios are conceptual suggestions, never described as approved operations.
belt_wide_defaults.switchback_trigger: one safety-grade event requiring human takeover, OR 90-day complaint/takeover-failure rate above threshold; thresholds set from Phase-1 measured baselines, then published (no fictitious pre-filled numbers)
belt_wide_defaults.recovery_condition: two consecutive clean review cycles + one yellow observation period before returning to green; switchback judgement decides reversion only, not effectiveness

roles_model.accountable_operator: single named operator per pilot (to be named at pilot approval; null until then)
